title: vstack Projection Envelope
description: Base envelope for all vstack projection artifacts. Every projection file must conform to this envelope structure.

schemaVersion.description: Internal schema version for this projection type. Incremented for breaking changes within a protocol version.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version identifying the contract set. Incremented for breaking changes across projection types.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this projection was generated

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision number for this specific projection file

producer.description: Metadata about the component that produced this projection

component.description: Component identifier that produced this projection

version.description: Semantic version of the producing component

description: All vstack projections share this base envelope. Specific projection types extend this with their own payload properties.
